findings.evidence: NEW round-2 finding. config/idempotency.php line 20: `'enabled' => env('IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED', false)` — verified in source. Project .env contains BROADCAST_DRIVER=pusher and QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync but NO IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED entry — defaults to FALSE. app/Http/Middleware/IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php line 41-43: `if (!config('idempotency.enabled', false)) return $next($request);` — middleware is a NO-OP for ALL requests in dev/test. Result: HTTP-level idempotency guard (replay caching, 425 race-wait, 409 conflict, Idempotency-Replayed header) is GLOBALLY DISABLED. Service-layer dedup via app-level UNIQUE(branch_id, idempotency_key) on `orders` table is the only line of defense; capture report confirms PHASE 16 round-2 created [391, 392] = 2 distinct orders sharing one X-Idempotency-Key, dedup happened at SQL UNIQUE not at middleware. NF525 / payment-safety risk: any duplicate POST under network retry that escapes the UNIQUE constraint (e.g. distinct keys generated client-side under race) creates N orders with N fiscal sequence allocations. SYNC-6 audit assertion CANNOT be validated without flipping this flag. CRITICAL: the same flag is likely defaulting to false in production unless explicitly set in deploy env — verify production env immediately.
